quote.text: A man should be upright, not be kept upright.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Instill values in your children by embodying integrity yourself, so they learn to stand tall on their own merit rather than needing constant correction.
    • Encourage self-discipline and inner virtue, allowing them the space to grow into upright individuals who understand the worth of ethical behavior.
  • Leadership
    • True leadership is grounded in personal virtue; by being steadfast in your ethics, you inspire your team to embrace the same upright principles.
    • Focus on creating an environment where individuals are motivated by inner conviction instead of external enforcement, leading to a naturally strong and resilient organization.
  • Product Management
    • Develop products that stand on solid ethical and quality foundations, reflecting the principle that true excellence does not rely solely on external checks or corrections.
    • Empower your teams to own their work with pride and integrity, ensuring that the product evolves from genuine commitment rather than oversight alone.
